# Counseling Center at Cinco Ranch

> A comprehensive mental health counseling practice in Katy, TX offering therapy for individuals, couples, families, and children across diverse conditions including trauma, anxiety, depression, and relationship issues.

Located in Katy, TX 77494, the Counseling Center at Cinco Ranch provides evidence-based counseling services including EMDR therapy, CBT, and family therapy. The practice serves clients across all ages and specializes in trauma treatment, mental health conditions, and relationship counseling with a team of licensed therapists.

## Key Topics

- EMDR therapy
- Trauma and PTSD treatment
- Anxiety and depression counseling
- Couples and marriage therapy
- Family therapy
- Individual therapy
- Katy, TX mental health services
- Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT)
- Grief and bereavement support
- Children and adolescent counseling
- Relationship counseling
- Licensed therapists
- Emotional support services
- Online booking
- Autism and neurodivergence support

## Individual Mental Health Therapy

- [Anxiety Treatment | Cinco Ranch Counseling](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/anxiety-treatment): Anxiety and panic attack treatment services in Katy, TX
- [Depression Therapy | Cinco Ranch Counseling](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/depression-treatment): Depression treatment for clients of all ages in Katy, TX
- [Trauma Therapy & PTSD Treatment in Katy, TX](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/counseling-for-trauma): Trauma-informed PTSD treatment by certified professionals
- [EMDR | Counseling Center at Cinco Ranch](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/emdr-therapy): EMDR therapy for trauma and PTSD processing
- [Eating Disorder Treatment | Katy, TX](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/eating-disorder-treatment): Treatment for anorexia, bulimia, and disordered eating
- [Grief & Bereavement Counseling | Katy, TX](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/grief-bereavement-counseling): Professional grief and bereavement support for all ages

## Specialized Population Services

- [Counseling for Young Adults | Cinco Ranch Counseling](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/young-adults): Therapy for young adults with depression, anxiety, and trauma
- [Counseling for Men | Katy, TX](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/counseling-for-men): Mental health counseling addressing men's issues and stigma
- [Counseling for Women | Katy, TX](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/counseling-women-issues-katy-tx): Therapy for women's mental health and life transitions
- [Counseling for Kids | Cinco Ranch Counseling](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/kids): Play therapy and counseling for children with anxiety and trauma
- [Counseling for Autism - Counseling Center at Cinco Ranch](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/autism): Autism counseling with CBT and social skills training

- [Counseling for Divorce | Katy, TX](https://cincoranchcounseling.com/service/counseling-for-divorce): Divorce counseling for emotional support and coping
